% with no blank line before it, is an item, and the words after its number
% name it. A bold theorem head inside a paragraph is not an item. Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
Every compact space is bounded.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Take a cover by balls. We consider the following cases.\\
{\bf Case 1:} The cover is finite. Then the space is bounded.
\textsf{Case 2.} The cover is infinite. Take a finite subcover, and note
\textbf{Theorem 1} as stated holds for it.
\paragraph{Step 1: Bound the radius} Take the largest radius.
\ul{Step 2}. Add the distances.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
